summary: Iteration 14 — Phase 3 Supplementari. Tested: email dispatch for partner-application, IT content master update (forbidden words removal), locale autodetect (detectBrowserLocale), frontend partner form submit flow. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend critical flows working.

minor.issue: No public endpoint available to verify studio_email_dispatch_log programmatically via API — email dispatch correctness verified indirectly (fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task, application rows created successfully). Resend is live (no mock).

integration_issues.issue: Teaser eyebrow shows 'COMING SOON' (EN) even when homepage is in IT. Same carry-over from iter 13 — locale autodetect works (nav shows Italian) but teaser uses a separate translation path that defaults to EN. LOW priority.

issues: Nested <a> inside <a> causes hydration warning in console: MoodLogo inside a LinkWithRef is itself a LinkWithRef — <a> descendent of <a>. Not a visual bug but a console error.

action_items: LOW: Fix nested <a> in <a> hydration warning — MoodLogo inside footer LinkWithRef wraps another LinkWithRef, creating <a> inside <a>.
LOW: DesignJourneyTeaser still shows EN 'COMING SOON' even when page locale is IT — minor locale translation miss.
critical_code_review_comments: asyncio.create_task() for email dispatch in corporate.py is correct pattern (fire-and-forget), but if the event loop is not running at that point (test context), tasks may be silently dropped. In production FastAPI this is safe.

partner_applications.id is UUID type (gen_random_uuid() without ::text cast) which is correct but inconsistent with contact_submissions which uses gen_random_uuid()::text — minor inconsistency from previous iteration, harmless.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (partner form submit works, locale autodetect working — minor teaser EN issue persists from iter 13)

seed_data_creation: Test partner applications created via POST tests with TEST_ prefix emails (iter14 suffix)
